product_name: Alcatel V3 Pro 5G (Metallic Grey, 8GB+256GB) | India’s 1st Patented NXTPAPER Superior Display | 50MP AI Dual Camera | NFC, 2TB Expandable Memory | Gemini in-Built | with Charger
description: India’s 1st Patented NXTPAPER Superior Display - Featuring full-color electronic paper 6.67" display smartphone with ultra-smooth 120Hz refresh rate. Enjoy a paper-like, anti-glare screen certified by TÜV Rheinland, SGS, and Eyesafe for superior eye comfort. Switch between Max Ink, Ink Paper, and Color Paper modes to suit reading, writing, or multimedia - ideal for long usage without strain, even under sunlight. AI Camera with Stunning Detail - Capture every shot with a 50MP AI main camera, a 5MP ultra-wide lens, and an 8MP selfie camera for crystal-clear photos. AI enhancements like Magic Eraser, Magic Editor, and Photo Unblur help you shoot, edit, and share social-ready content effortlessly - from landscapes to portraits. AI-Powered Performance Meets Massive Storage - Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G processor, this phone offers a fast 2.4GHz performance with up to 18GB RAM (8GB + 10GB expandable RAM) and 256GB storage, expandable up to 2TB. Seamlessly multitask, stream, or game lag-free while Gemini AI enhances your productivity with smart summaries, planning tools, and Google app integration. Long Battery Life with Smart Charging - Stay ahead with a 5200mAh battery designed for all-day usage. AI smart saving adjusts refresh rates and dims brightness for better efficiency. Get quick boosts with 18W charging and enjoy peace of mind with built-in overcharge protection that extends battery health by up to 15%. Built to Entertain, Built to Last - Enjoy cinematic surround sound with dual stereo speakers and stream, game, or browse with immersive clarity. Stay protected with IP54 splash and dust resistance, side fingerprint unlock, and built-in NFC for secure, contactless payments. With 3 years of OS updates and 4 years of security updates, it’s a true all-rounder built for long-term performance, safety, and convenience.
